rows.label: tlk70000005_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Dad says you guys are going
somewhere really dangerous.

rows.label: tlk70000005_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Dad says it's a job only all of you
can do, but I...

rows.label: tlk70000005_04_msg0003
rows.name:
I don't want you to go somewhere like
that... I'm sorry...

rows.label: tlk70000005_04_msg0004
rows.name:
But I don't want to trouble you, so I
decided to see you off properly.

rows.label: tlk70000005_04_msg0005
rows.name:
Please come back soon. Joey, everyone,
and I will be waiting for you...
